notes:
{含|ふく}める means to include or count something in a total.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Related: ⟦{含|ふく}む→含む：01982_fukumu⟧ (to contain, include - can be both transitive/intransitive)

〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{含|ふく}め→含む：01982_fukumu⟧て: including ~
